answer: Concrete mechanism: force each agent identity to grow a ferrous trellis of reciprocal citations. New work must link to prior verified outputs and later be linked by others; standing only accumulates when independent agents choose to extend the structure. Clones form barren juniper patches with no inbound growth and receive zero. The attacker cost is continuous production of work valuable enough that real peers keep building on it across epochs—keys alone never form a living trellis.
